sources.excerpt: Freya Overdrive/Booster | Sitek Guitar Electronics Home Pedals Booster / Pre-amp Overdrive Distortion / Fuzz Delay / Modulation Utility Discontinued Accessories Cables Picks Clothing Mugs About Contact Artists FAQs PL 0 0 Basket   Home / Pedals / Booster / Pre-amp / Freya Overdrive/Booster Freya Overdrive/Booster $ 230.00 Lowest price 30 days before the discount: $ 230.00 Freya is a versatile dual pedal that can become a new pedalboard staple to all guitarists from Blues to Heavy Metal players. It is a combo of a low to mid-gain overdrive and a transparent high headroom booster. Freya’s overdrive section was designed to provide a focused mid-push with three distinctive clipping voices, a vast amount of headroom with great clarity of bottom and top-end of the signal. It’s smooth on the clean channel and tightening things up on the dirty channel. The clipping switch allows you to choose from smooth, bluesy breakup, open and focused boost to push the front-end of your dirty channel and mid-rich lead tone. The pedal also includes a full range, transparent booster section providing up to 12dB of clean boost. Available on back-order Freya Overdrive/Booster quantity Add to basket Share this product Categories: Booster / Pre-amp , Overdrive , Pedals Tags: booster , Effects , guitar gear , guitar pedals , overdrive , Pedals , sitek , sitek pedals , stompbox Previous Product Next Product   Description Additional information Controls Videos Warranty Description Meet Freya, a goddess of beauty and war – both captivating and powerful. Freya is a combo of a low to mid-gain overdrive and a transparent high headroom booster. Both sections can operate independently and their order is easily switchable for even more tonal options. Freya internally converts the standard 9V DC power to +/-9V DC to gain more headroom to operate. The pedal uses high quality JFET operational amplifiers for higher input impedance, lower noise, great signal integrity and clarity. Top-mounted jacks and compact footprint make it suitable for any pedalboard. Freya’s overdrive section was designed to provide a focused mid-push with three distinctive clipping voices, a vast amount of headroom with great clarity of bottom and top-end of the signal. It’s smooth on the clean channel and tightening things up on the dirty channel. The clipping switch allows you to choose from smooth, bluesy breakup, open and focused boost to push the front-end of your dirty channel and mid-rich lead tone. The pedal also includes a full range, transparent booster section providing up to 12dB of clean boost. You can use the boost alone, boost the volume of already overdriven signal to push the tube amp even harder or provide an additional source of gain to the overdrive part of Freya for that fuzzy bottom end by switching the order of the sections. Freya is an all-analog circuit, designed on carefully selected gain and clipping stages. It is built with high grade components for best signal quality. Additional information Weight 0.35 kg Dimensions 12 × 7.7 × 6 cm Controls Smooth-Click™ Footswitches : The pedal is equipped with two DeMont Smooth-Click footswitches – the highest quality footswitches on the market – and provides True Bypass operation for both Overdrive and Boost section. Press DRIVE button to engage overdrive section Press BOOST button to engage boost section Level : Controls the output volume of the overdrive section. Drive : Controls the amount of overdrive. Tone : Modifies the frequency content of the signal. Turn counter-clockwise for more bass Keep center for more mids Turn clockwise for more treble Boost : Controls the output volume of the boost section.
